tasks.subject: [notification-system] [P1] Enforce the one-error-one-toast contract across every mutation
tasks.description: Sweep all double-toast sites (research §6 item 1: create agent, create channel/DM, all binding CRUD in IntegrationsTab, adapter toggle, rename session, onboarding/tours patches): each mutation declares meta.errorLabel or meta.suppressErrorToast so the global MutationCache.onError in query-client.ts is the ONLY failure toast, carrying the real reason. Delete hand-rolled duplicate onError toasts. Add a contract test (one-create-surface.test.ts style) that scans client source and fails on any toast call inside a mutation onError whose mutation lacks meta. Acceptance: contract test red when a violation is seeded, green on the tree; the ~10 cited flows show exactly one toast on failure.

NO escalation, NO web-push yet (4.3). Acceptance: runtime conformance untouched; collectDurableEvents integration test sees notification SSE for a run-terminal; ask-answer-conformance-style test proves agent principals cannot read/mutate; own-action drop unit test; history-row-on-resolve unit test.

tasks.subject: [notification-system] [P4] Web push + the escalation ladder
tasks.description: services/notifications/channels/web-push.ts (web-push npm; VAPID keypair generated on first use at <dorkHome>/push/vapid.json 0600; subscriptions CRUD routes + prune on 404/410; payload = title/body/deep-link only — never tool inputs); client service worker (public/sw.js: push → showNotification, click → focus/open deep link) + subscribe UI in Settings → Notifications (this browser, list/remove devices); escalation-service.ts: Blocking kinds arm phoneAfterMinutes timer, cancelled by ANY ack (interaction resolved, schedule decided, ledger seen/acted, notification read), fires web-push + relay leg (resolveNotifyTarget, canInitiate + NotifyBudget respected), re-arms from pending state on boot idempotently via ledger. Acceptance: escalation unit tests cover every cancel path + boot re-arm + 'never'; web-push mocked at module boundary; integration test: parked ask older than delay + no acks → exactly one escalation ledger row.
